content: Formspree Webhook plugin POSTs JSON to any URL on every submission, configured via formspree.json actions array or dashboard plugin UI. IMPORTANT: Webhooks require a paid Formspree plan (Personal $10/mo or higher) - not available on free plan. Alternative: if the existing form submits via JS/fetch (not a raw HTML POST), add a second client-side POST to your own /api/inquiries endpoint alongside the Formspree submission to avoid the webhook fee entirely.
